items.title: Cursor capitalizes on GitHub frustration, launches rival hosting platform
items.summary: Cursor, known for its AI Code Editor, is launching a new code-hosting platform to rival developers' long preferred favorite, GitHub.

items.title: ChatGPT Ads expands across Europe
items.summary: ChatGPT Ads is expanding to 31 European markets. Learn how advertisers can reach people as they explore, compare options, and make decisions.

items.title: Strengthening democratic oversight in national security
items.summary: OpenAI launches an initiative to strengthen democratic oversight of AI in national security, supporting government institutions with tools, training, and expertise.

items.summary: How Much Memory Does Your Agent Actually Need?

items.title: OpenAI institutes new safeguards after Hugging Face breach
items.summary: The new safeguards include more detailed monitoring of models during the development process, as well as greater emphasis on alignment and security during the post-training process.

items.title: Etched’s valuation doubles to $21B in a month
items.summary: Jane Street has installed Etched's first shipped AI cluster system, and was so impressed, it led another massive round, the startup says.

items.title: Why Apple’s camera-equipped AirPods may not be the ‘pervert pods’ consumers fear
items.summary: Apple’s leaked camera-equipped AirPods might avoid the privacy pitfalls of other AI wearables by preventing users from recording photos and videos.

items.title: Warp’s new system is an out-of-the-box software factory for AI development
items.summary: On Tuesday, Warp introduced Warp Factories, a new infrastructure system designed to make building AI software factories as easy as possible.

items.title: OpenAI launches a safer ChatGPT for teens — years after teens started using it
items.summary: ChatGPT for Teens adds age-appropriate safety measures, parental controls, and learning tools designed to steer teens away from harmful content — and from using AI to cheat on their homework.

items.title: Perplexity’s free AI offer left it with millions more users in India
items.summary: Perplexity's India revenue rose about 60% after the Airtel offer ended for new users, even as downloads declined.

items.title: Partnering with CodeAI to prepare the first AI generation
items.summary: OpenAI and CodeAI are partnering to help students build AI literacy, think critically about AI, and develop the skills to use and shape it responsibly.

items.title: Pacing model development in an era of cyber-critical capabilities
items.summary: OpenAI is strengthening monitoring, alignment, and security for frontier AI models. See how new safeguards are guiding the pace of model development.
